_comment: Keys that are deliberately empty in a target locale, because that language reorders the sentence and the segment carries no words. Format: '<lang>/<namespace>:<key.path>'. Anything listed here is skipped by i18n-translate.mjs instead of being treated as a gap.
tr/common:hero.scenarios.shortcut.seg3: Turkish fronts the goal phrase — seg1+seg2 already carry the full headline.
tr/home:problemRecognition.title.pre: Turkish starts the sentence with the gold-highlighted word, so the lead-in segment is empty.
